tools.name: get_city_facts
tools.description: Field-verified facts a foreign traveler needs for a Chinese city: which attractions need real-name/passport booking and when tickets release, official ticket channels (no resellers), whether hotels register foreign guests, whether foreign cards work via Alipay/WeChat, and honest local notes. Use for

tools.name: check_attraction_booking
tools.description: How a foreigner books a specific Chinese attraction: real-name/passport requirement, ticket release time, whether it sells out, the OFFICIAL channel, and whether authorized resellers exist. Use for 'can foreigners book the Forbidden City / Terracotta Army / Mogao Caves and when do tickets release'.

tools.name: check_transit_eligibility
tools.description: Whether a traveler qualifies for China's 240-hour visa-free TRANSIT (not the 30-day visa-free entry). Needs nationality, the entry port/city, and whether they have an onward ticket to a THIRD country/region. Returns eligibility, regional limits, and the defining conditions.

tools.name: search_cities
tools.description: Search the cities TravelerLocal has field-verified pages for. Returns matching city names and page URLs. Use to discover coverage or resolve a place to a city.

tools.name: get_travel_playbook
tools.description: TravelerLocal's field-verified stance on the system-level things foreigners get wrong in China (not a specific place): paying when a foreign card fails, eSIM vs VPN and the firewall, the Chinese-phone-number wall, the first hour after landing, hotel foreigner-registration, and visa-free transit.
